subject: English
title: CISCE curriculum: English, Class II

source.read: A third-party copy of the Class II pages of the CISCE curriculum (English: printed pages 10 to 13), hosted by BYJU'S
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. The pages do not name their publisher or year, and were read through a text summary of the PDF, not the PDF itself. The official document on cisce.org could not be reached from the build environment. CISCE is understood not to prescribe a textbook for this class, so a school's own book and term plan may order or extend these topics.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words with a pointer to its strand and line; no curriculum text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from a secondary source; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Reads aloud or silently with understanding.

outcomes.text: Writes answers to questions on a passage.
outcomes.note: Answers are chosen from three, not written.

outcomes.text: Writes three- and four-letter words and sentences from dictation.
Writes a paragraph of eight to ten lines on a topic.
outcomes.note: Written in the essay studio, a separate part of the app that is still being built. Its tasks are not yet matched to this class.

outcomes.text: Writes about personal experiences or real situations.

outcomes.text: Recognises nouns, verbs, adjectives, the joining words and and but, and prepositions.
Uses common and proper nouns, and nouns that can and cannot be counted.
Uses capital letters, commas and question marks correctly.
Uses myself, ourselves, himself, herself and the like correctly.
Works out a word's meaning from the words around it.
outcomes.note: New words teaches meanings in sentences; guessing an unknown word from its sentence is not asked directly.

outcomes.text: Uses words and phrases suited to the class.
Knows and uses words that sound alike, opposites and words of the same meaning.
